From: Irene Choi <irene@redwood.com>

Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 30 Nov 2026 15:02:00 -0800
Subject: Post-call recap & proposed pilot boundaries (Halcyon)

Alec / Maya — thanks again for the time today. Quick recap from our conversation and a proposal for the pilot we discussed. I captured what I heard; please flag anything I missed.

Top pain points you shared
- High latency and cost for document understanding flows at 10k qps windows (esp. during end-of-quarter processing).
- Inconsistent entity extraction accuracy across PDFs and scanned images (OCR variability).
- No easy way to route lower-confidence results for human review — manual triage is slow.

Pilot goals / success metrics (proposal)
- Latency: median response < 350ms for interactive queries (95th < 900ms).
- Cost: reduce per-document inference cost by >= 35% vs current baseline by leveraging batching and quantized model variant.
- Quality: F1 for entity extraction >= 0.86 on your V1 eval set; human-review rate <= 8% for the pilot workload.
- Reliability: 99.5% uptime during pilot business hours (8–20 PT).

Scope (90-day pilot)
- Ingest path: S3 bucket with PDF and OCR outputs you provided (sample subset of ~5k documents).
- Processing: Redwood-hosted inference using a medium-sized model variant (quantized 8-bit) + caching for repeated prefixes.
- Outputs: structured JSON entity sets + confidence scores; optional reranking for top-3 summaries.

Owners & roles
- Halcyon: Alec Ford (PoC/data access), Maya Singh (Data & security), Procurement (PO/contract).
- Redwood: Irene Choi (Engagement lead), Karthik Iyer (Solutions & ops), Ben Carter (Customer success / evals).

Timeline highlights
- Week 0 (this week): access + sample data; finalize pilot scope doc (attached).
- Week 1: infra access & test runs; share initial eval script & seed prompt set.
- Week 2–4: iterative tuning, prompt/eval loops, quality checks.
- Week 5–12: scale to full sample and monitor metrics; weekly check-ins.

Immediate asks for Halcyon
1) Provide S3 read-only credentials for the sample subset and an IAM role ARN for cross-account.
2) Share the V1 eval set (CSV) and a short description of current OCR pipeline.
3) Confirm data retention requirement for pilot logs (you mentioned 30 days during call).

Attachments in this message
- halcyon_pilot_scope_v1.pdf (pilot scope and acceptance criteria)

Next steps
- If this reflects your expectations, can we lock in a technical kickoff on Thursday 12/3 at 10am PT? Karthik and Ben will join.

Thanks — I’ll standing-up the access checklist and post the initial eval script to the shared folder once I have S3 details.

Best,
Irene Choi
Engagement Lead, Redwood Inference
